status: proposed platform defaults, not NU assessment policy

readiness.purpose: Route prerequisite repair, without awarding course completion or blocking exploration.
readiness.repair: Use available MTH 215 lesson links, course pages labeled under construction for PHS 104/CSC 208/CSC 209, and verified free resources. Do not label these prerequisites complete based on this short screen.

lessonPractice.modes: Seeded practice with three graduated hints, explicit checks, complete solutions, and unlimited fresh forms. Each part must have a useful label, unit, and input rule.
lessonPractice.independence: Practice, solution viewing, and interaction feedback are learning assistance, not independent achievement.

checkpoint.rule: At least three fully correct items, including every critical model-validity item, with no hints. An item with several fields is correct only if all are correct. Existing evidence semantics remain compatible; this checkpoint is initial evidence, not proof of retained mastery.
checkpoint.coverage: Two quantitative items with different reasoning, one interpretation item, and one transfer or error-diagnosis item; at least two families.

moduleQuizzes.blueprint: Every lesson objective appears in four items using at least two families. At least one conceptual/model item per lesson; all essential critical checks are mapped. Eight-item forms are a deliberate exception to the roadmap's suggested 10 to 15 where a module contains two substantial lessons.
moduleQuizzes.rule: Independent, untimed by default; feedback after submission. Require at least 75 percent per objective and all critical items. A high module total cannot hide a weak objective. Snapshot questions, versions, responses, and seed so a reload or generator update cannot change the form.

cumulative.rule: One item per lesson per part, using complementary quantitative and model-interpretation forms across the two parts. Both parts plus the project rubric and lesson/module evidence are required for a completion recommendation. The two shorter sessions avoid a single very long browser attempt.
cumulative.tools: Calculator and supplied constants permitted; formulas may be consulted in practice. Independent assessments disclose their supplied formulas and any permitted reference sheet. These are self-study defaults, not NU exam rules.
cumulative.critical: Resolve every critical model, unit, conservation-condition, and domain failure with a fresh targeted check.
cumulative.limits: These forms are not psychometrically calibrated or substitutes for NU examinations.

targetedReview.selection: Group missed questions by original lesson objective and provide its lesson link and fresh practice. A later successful review updates review evidence without deleting earlier attempts.
targetedReview.delay: Recommend a fresh independent set after seven days for retained understanding. Preserve the existing lesson checkpoint's three-day recall cue as initial review; do not relabel it as seven-day retention.
targetedReview.noFalseMastery: Do not grant whole-course completion from opening lessons, self-reported confidence, resource visits, practice scores, or a project self-rating alone.

familyAcceptance.determinism: Identical family version, variant, seed, and item ID produce identical snapshots.
independentChecks: Derive expected answers in fixtures using a different relation or direct symbolic/physical invariant, not by copying each answer field.
Test equivalent rational and decimal values within stated tolerances, valid negative components, zero cases, and alternative permitted units only where the UI actually supports them.
Reject blank, nonfinite, malformed, wrong-unit, and out-of-domain inputs without crashing.
Use conservation residuals, force balances, dimensional exponents, orthogonality, and limiting cases as cross-checks.
Cover endpoints: zero velocity, zero work, equal masses, zero net force or torque, threshold friction, zero vector, and contact loss.
Validate all formula rendering and readable alternatives; force every specified variant to reject unknown variant names.
Keep randomized conceptual option positions and enough distinct scenarios to avoid answer-position memorization.

persistence.reuse: Use the existing versioned study store, validated snapshots, conflict handling, and JSON backup. Backward-compatible shared extensions are separately committed.
persistence.capacity: Measure a realistic course history against the current 50 MB backup budget and 5,000-attempt policy before declaring completion; present visible capacity recovery and preserve exported attempts. Never silently delete old work.
persistence.verification: Check reload mid-answer, refresh mid-assessment, export/import with learning evidence, malformed imports without data loss, quota failure, and concurrent revisions.
